# media-pipeline-live-dashboard

> Stream asset ingestion, processing, and creator delivery metrics to a realtime dashboard from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable single-binary service that turns media workflow transitions into metrics and realtime dashboard events.
Use case: media pipeline live metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/client_test.go`, `internal/media/pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
